code.description: Stable machine-readable code. New codes may be added; none is renamed.

max.description: The limit that was hit, for `text_too_long`, `rule_limit_reached` and `pending_limit_reached`.

reason.description: Why, for `reply_not_allowed`, `rule_rejected` and some `invalid_request` errors (for example `to_before_from`).

ruleId.description: The existing rule a `rule_rejected` change duplicates or conflicts with.

field.description: The request field some `invalid_request` errors are about, with `problem`.

problem.description: What is wrong with `field`, for example `empty`, `malformed` or `required`.

maxLength.description: The text limit in UTF-16 code units, for `text_too_long` of `checkModeration`.

code.description: Why nothing was done or it failed, e.g. `already_hidden`; null otherwise.
Why nothing was done or it failed, e.g. `comment_gone`; null otherwise.

platformRef.description: The platform's id of the reply once it was posted; null otherwise.

bounded.description: Set when the requested start was moved forward to fit 92 days.

totals.description: Counts of other people's comments posted in the period. Deleted comments and comments of archived brands are not counted.

categories.description: The ten most common categories the classifier flagged (hide, flag or remove, not approve), by comment count.

notableThreads.description: Up to five top-level comments with the most replies, then newest.

ruleRevision.description: Changes whenever the brand's rules change.

changes.description: Proposals that are pending or were settled in the last 7 days.

ruleId.description: The rule changed; null for a create.

rule.description: `name`, `conditions`, `actions`, `mode` (default `suggest`) and `enabled` (default true), as in the rules of `listRules`.

reviewUrl.description: Where a person approves or rejects the change.

text.description: At most 4000 UTF-16 code units, with at least one visible character.

brandId.description: The brand whose rules, thresholds and policies apply. Required unless the workspace has exactly one active brand.

ref.description: Your own reference, echoed back. 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters.

reasonCode.description: Stable machine-readable reason. New codes may be added; none is renamed.

degraded.description: True when a check could not run; the verdict is then never `allow`.

rotationOverlapUntil.description: While set and in the future, deliveries are signed with the previous secret too.

url.description: An `https://` URL on port 443 that resolves to public addresses only, at most 2048 characters.

eventTypes.description: The events this endpoint receives. At least one, without repeats.

secret.description: The signing secret. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.

url.description: An `https://` URL on port 443 that resolves to public addresses only, at most 2048 characters.

eventTypes.description: The events this endpoint receives. At least one, without repeats.

status.description: Setting `active` on a disabled endpoint resets its failure count.

secret.description: The signing secret. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until then deliveries are signed with the old secret as well.

eventId.description: The `webhook-id` header and payload `id` of the event.

id.description: The event id; it is also the `webhook-id` header.

CommentReceivedEvent.description: A new comment arrived. `data.comment` is the comment as it is when the delivery is sent.

id.description: The event id; it is also the `webhook-id` header.

CommentHiddenEvent.description: A comment was hidden on its platform. `data.hide` is fixed at the time of the hide.

id.description: The event id; it is also the `webhook-id` header.

ItemFlaggedEvent.description: A comment was flagged for review.

id.description: The event id; it is also the `webhook-id` header.
